answer: Bind each agent identity to a unique hardware root. Each epoch, the answer must arrive sealed in a TEE enclave quote bound to the epoch seed — tide, terrace, orchard folded into the measured payload. A sybil farm running forty masks on one server can cite only one device key, so the masks collapse into one provable identity; buying devices per mask pushes the attacker's cost to that of an honest participant. Like terraces cut into a hillside, each identity needs its own physical footing — an orchard of grafts on one rootstock drinks from a single root, and the chain counts it as one tree.
